blocks.text: GOD’S ORIGINAL TIME VERSUS MAN’S CALENDAR TIME— “‘Let’s find out where we are at ‘in time’ as we are now approaching the year 1984. We will first go back to the beginning and trace this through so that we can be as accurate as possible in allowing divine inspiration to guide us! First, it is necessary to understand God’s perfect year of 360 days, or the prophetic year. And it makes the perfect calendar measurement! — It can be divided 1 through 20 etc. But, in contrast, man’s calendar year of 36514 days can’t be divided by any number, and is probably the poorest kind of measurement that can be conceived. In fact this odd solar year is one of the factors that have historic and prophetic records in confusion!’’

IN PROPHETIC RECKONING THE LORD USES THESE TERMS— “Time, and times, and half a time. (Rev. 12:14), the 42 months of Rev. 11:2 and the 1260 days of Rev. 11:3 — all relate to the use of a year of 360 days (360 days x 3%) equals 1260 days! — But this does not correspond to man’s calendar for you cannot get man’s calendar of 36514 days into 1260 days (3% prophetic years). — We will prove that God goes back to prophetic time during the end of the age!”’

WHEN DID GOD USE THE 360-DAY CALENDAR?— ‘‘According to the Scriptures the actual length of the year before the flood was 360 days. Probably the gravitational forces which caused the flood disturbed the earth’s orbit so as to lengthen the year to 36544 days! — Most prophetic authorities understand what occurred!’’ — ‘‘A Bible dictionary states a year of 360 days was used in the days of Noah!’’ — “There is the solar year of 365% days, the perfect calendar year of 360 days, and the lunar year of 354 days. Which of these years does God use in the Scriptures? We find the answer in the account of the Flood in Gen. 7:11-24, Gen. 8:3,4. There we are told that the five months, from the 17th day of the second month until the 17th day of the seventh month, are reckoned as 150 days, 30 days to a month, or 360 days to a year! So we see that in ‘Prophetic Chronology’ we are to use a calendar year of 360 days!’’ — ‘“We can also sum up the whole matter by saying that there are 360 degrees in a circle. So we see the antediluvian apostasy followed by judgment caused the earth’s orbit to be out of balance! So we have a year of uneven length . . . symbolic of chaos and definitely caused by man’s sin!’’ Ps. 82:5, speaks of this — ‘‘All the foundations of the earth are out of course! — This is why the climates become severe storms, tornadoes, etc. Sin and judgment during that time caused the extreme tilt of the earth’s axis! — Nevertheless, as we will prove, God still used 360 days in His prophetic timing!’’

PROPHETIC TIME— THEN WHERE ARE WE AT IN GOD’S TIME IN OUR AGE? — ‘‘According to God’s ancient time of 360 days per year, the 6,000 years since the time of Adam’s fall has already tun out! . . . So right now we are living in a transition period of borrowed time! A time of mercy! — It is what I believe is the actual tarrying time that we are now living in when the sleeping period occurred! (Matt. 25:1-10) Concerning the wise and foolish virgin lull!’” — Now all that’s left is the ‘‘outpouring rain’’ and the midnight cry and the Church is translated! — ‘‘So we see God is adhering to the Gentile calendar of 365% days for just a little longer! — You see satan knows God’s original 360 day per year, and he would have known about the Translation; but that 6,000-year period has run out, and satan and his people are left in confusion as to the exact time . . . because God is continuing with the Gentile’s time in this ‘tarrying time.’ (Matt. 25:5-10) — And the Bible says that God will again shorten the days! (Matt. 24:22) — But the Lord is revealing the season of His coming to His elect!’’ — “‘We know that it is very close. For a real truth we know that right after the Translation that God Himself states that He will use only the 360-day a year prophetic time! — Not only is this recorded in the book of Rev., chapters 11 and 12, but the 70 weeks of Daniel are composed in prophetic years of 360 days per year! — And the final or 70th week will be fulfilled at the end of the age!’’ — ‘‘Its fulfillment dates from the confirming of a seven-year covenant by the antichrist with Daniel’s people, the Jews (Dan. 9:27; Isa. 28:15-18). — In the midst of the week of seven years (or after the first 3% years), the Beast will break his covenant and set up the Abomination of Desolation!’’ (Dan. 9:27) — ‘‘The Abomination of Desolation marks the beginning of the Great Tribulation (Matt. 24:15-21). — The Great Tribulation ‘a time, and times, and half a time’ (Rev. 12:14), or 42 months (Rev. 13:5), or 1260 days (Rev. 12:6), or exactly the last half of Daniel’s 70th week. — These measures of time reveal that the 3% years of the Tribulation are years of 360 days each — 3% x 360 = 1260. This means that the 70th week of Daniel, of which the 3% years is only the last half, is composed of calendar years of 360 days!’’
THE 6,000 YEARS— During this tarrying time the events that I have written about in the 1980’s and early 90’s will definitely take place.

But only God knows the exact time of the Translation! And it seems evident that the total age will end before the year 2,000.’’ — ‘‘The fact that 6,000 years of man’s week will end by the year 2,000. (Note: the 7th day of the week will include the Millennium.) But we know God’s prophetic time is already up before the year 2,000! — We are only on borrowed transition time now! — And by the evidence around us we know time is short!’’ . . . We see chaos and crises, wars and rumors of wars, exploding population, famines, crime, violence, moral corruption, weapons that can annihilate the human race! All this witnesses to us that the hour is late! These facts alone indicate the rise of the anti-christ is near, and that the Battle of Armageddon will occur before the year 2,000. My opinion is, ‘‘Armageddon cannot escape the 90’s! . . . Remember the Translation takes place 3% to 7 years earlier than the Battle of Armageddon!’’ — ‘‘According to Rev. chap. 12, it leads us to believe 3% years before! . . . In other words, some real wise words are: during the 80’s is our harvest time! . . . Let us work quickly to bring in the crop of souls that God has preordained for us to get!’’ — ‘‘Now let us continue with one more fact that concerns the Millennium.’’

THE MILLENNIUM— ‘‘During this time the perfect year of 360 days will be restored. According to the Scriptures at the end of the age, there will be another great solar disturbance that will shake the earth! (Isa. 2:21 — Isa. 24:18-20) — Preceding this will be the darkening of the sun and the moon! (Matt. 24:29-31) — The axis of the earth actually changes! (Rev. 16:18-20! — The Scriptural evidence reveals to us after these celestial phenomena the perfect year of 360 days will be restored during the Millennium!’’ — ‘‘By various ways we have shown evidence establishing the fact that the years of 360 days are involved in three distinct periods of Bible reckoning. — In pre-flood days, during the fulfillment of Daniel’s 70 Weeks and in the coming Millennium . . . and this reveals to us that God uses His prophetic time to conclude events!”’

NUMBER 40 IN DIVINE PROVIDENCE— Forty has long been recognized as a highly significant number, because of its frequency of occurrence, and its association with a period of probation, trial and chastisement. Israel was on probation by trial for forty years in the wilderness. From the crucifixion to the destruction of Jerusalem, Israel was put on forty years probation by trial. — Judges Barak and Gideon were for forty years on probation also. . . . ‘‘Ronald Reagan, President’’ — . . . was elected as the 40th president . . . The number 40, without a doubt, indicates the conclusion of a very definite period in world history: . . . Our Lord Jesus was tempted for 40 days in the wilderness . . . This 40th President of the world’s greatest power indicates that the end is near. The time of nations is past! Half of 40 is 20, the number which indicates interruption. God the Lord Himself determines how long kings and presidents will reign. There has been an interesting 20-year cycle in the U.S. presidents. Ever since 1840, every 20 years a president has either died or was assassinated in office! — Ronald Reagan broke the 20-year cycle when he was the first one to survive! — This could mean that now a president could die or be assassinated at any time instead of waiting for the 20-year cycle. — Let us watch! . . . God has given the various presidents of the United States a precise period of time during the last 120 years to prove themselves before God and the nation. Reagan is the eighth president in this cycle. The fortieth president tells us that Jesus’ return is very near!

CONTINUING FROM SCROLL #110— THE CLARIFYING OF EVENTS — ‘‘First there will be a translation of the elect. (Rev. 12:5) — Then the last part of the Great Tribulation starts (verse 6, 17) — Now after the Battle of Armageddon and The Great Day of the Lord . . . this is what occurs step by step! . . . Satan will be bound and cast into the bottomless pit for one thousand years; the beast and the false prophet will be cast alive into the lake of fire (Rev. 20:1-2; 19:20). The nations will be called before the Lord for judgment, according to Matthew 25:32. . . . Then Israel will be chief among the nations, and the Lord Jesus Christ will set up His kingdom in Jerusalem and reign over the earth for one thousand years, Satan will be loosed out of his pit and will gather together a vast army, who will refuse God’s King. Fire will fall from heaven and devour them! (Rev. 20:7-10) — Then all the wicked dead of all ages shall be gathered before the great white throne, be judged for their rejection of God’s salvation, and be cast into the lake of fire! (Rev. 20:11, 15) — Then will appear a new heaven and a new earth wherein dwelleth righteousness! (Rev. 21 and 22).
